title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_irena_s_children_by_tilar_j_mazzeo_s4ksn (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_irena_s_children_by_tilar_j_mazzeo_s4ksn' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected system should be rotated immediately from a different, trusted computer. Removal of the package alone does not guarantee elimination of the malicious software or control established by the attacker.
